views: view3: F3 2.00 x 2.00 plan + section (all three in this file)
warnings: Printed under F1: 'หมายเหตุ ถ้าเลือกใช้ฐานรากชนิดแผ่ (ฐานรากแบบที่2) สภาพชั้นดินจะต้องรับน้ำหนักบรรทุกปลอดภัยได้ไม่น้อยกว่า 8,000 กก./ตร.ม.' — the alternative to the pile footings of ฐานรากแบบที่ 1 (S-05, หน้า21) for the same marks F1/F2/F3; the title block says 'แบบขยายฐานรากแบบที่2 (ไม่มีเสาเข็ม)'.

Sloped footings: height_mm = edge thickness + slope rise to the pedestal, as printed on each section's vertical chain (F1 0.25 + 0.25, F2 0.20 + 0.20, F3 0.15 + 0.16); the 0.05 lean concrete and 0.10 sand below are not part of height_mm (section 6b).

F3's chain reads '0.15' (slope rise) over '0.16' (edge): the lower glyph has a closed lower bowl (a 6) while the '0.15' printed directly above it in the same font has the open-left bowl of a 5. Taken as printed (height 0.31); the series pattern (F1 0.25 + 0.25, F2 0.20 + 0.20) makes 0.15 + 0.15 = 0.30 plausible, so it is flagged edge_thickness_reads_0.16_possibly_0.15 with lowered confidence.

Mat callouts are tiny on the scan: F1 'Ø 15 mm. @ 0.08 m.#', F2 'Ø 15 mm. @ 0.10 m.# ℄-℄', F3 'Ø 12 mm. @ 0.08 m.# ℄-℄'. F2's spacing digit could be taken for 0.30 at a glance; decided 0.10 by pixel comparison with the '1' of '15' in the same callout (same 3 px stem and 5-6 px serif foot; a '3' or '0' in this font is 7 px wide) — flagged spacing_digit_low_resolution. F3's '8' shows both bowls; F1's last digit is filled in by the blur (8 or 6), read 0.08 like F3 and flagged. '℄-℄' = spacing measured centre to centre. The bar dots drawn in the sections are at a uniform ~0.10 m for all three footings, so they are schematic and were not used to decide spacing.

Depth note printed vertically beside every section: F1 and F2 read 'ความลึกถึงชั้นดินแข็ง หรือประมาณ 1.60 ม.', F3 reads '... ประมาณ 1.50 ม.' (upright zoom; the F1/F2 digit has the closed bowl of a 6, F3's the flat top of a 5). Recorded per footing as printed.

The mat is printed '#' (two-way grid by spacing) with no bar count, so main_bar carries dia_mm + spacing_mm and no count (section 6b: a footing that prints a repeating spacing uses spacing_mm and omits count). The column bars are drawn bent onto the mat (starter bars), not separately labelled.
